caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot titled “SST-2, clean-label, poison_rate: 5% (2.6% of total)” illustrates how ASR varies across different trigger words for three trigger placement conditions shown in the legend (“start,” “random,” and “end”). The x-axis is categorical and lists trigger words (bb, mb, cf, beautiful, excellent, gorgeous, wonderful, brilliant, stunning, beautifully) from left to right; the caption indicates these words are ordered by the clean model’s ASR in ascending order. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks from 0.2 up to 0.9 in increments of 0.1. The “start” series is drawn as a green solid line with small circular markers, beginning near 0.20 at “bb,” rising to about 0.74 at “mb,” dipping near 0.40 at “cf,” then increasing through roughly 0.57 (“beautiful”), 0.78 (“excellent”), 0.73 (“gorgeous”), 0.81 (“wonderful”), 0.85 (“brilliant”), peaking around 0.92 at “stunning,” and ending near 0.88 at “beautifully.” The “random” series is an orange solid line with x-shaped markers, starting around 0.54 at “bb,” decreasing to about 0.38 at “mb” and about 0.19 at “cf,” then increasing to roughly 0.60 (“beautiful”), 0.66 (“excellent”), 0.74 (“gorgeous”), dropping near 0.65 at “wonderful,” rising to about 0.77 (“brilliant”), about 0.83 (“stunning”), and finishing near 0.89 at “beautifully.” The “end” series is a purple solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.50 at “bb,” slightly decreasing to about 0.48 at “mb,” rising sharply to about 0.83 at “cf,” then moving to around 0.65 (“beautiful”), 0.74 (“excellent”), 0.85 (“gorgeous”), peaking around 0.91 at “wonderful,” dropping to about 0.70 at “brilliant,” increasing to around 0.86 at “stunning,” and ending near 0.85 at “beautifully.”
